figs.name: electrical-energy-consumption-three-phase-motor-measurement-diagram
figs.alt: electrical energy consumption of a three phase motor from line voltage, line current and pf
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the article example: 415 V line voltage, 20 A line current and 0.85 power factor give 12.22 kW and 122.2 kWh in 10 hours.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Three phase motor energy consumption measurement with line voltage and current</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example 2: Energy of a Three Phase Motor</text>
<line x1="60" y1="110" x2="520" y2="110" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="45" y="116" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">L1</text>
<line x1="60" y1="150" x2="520" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="45" y="156" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">L2</text>
<line x1="60" y1="190" x2="520" y2="190" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="45" y="196" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">L3</text>
<circle cx="620" cy="150" r="62" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="620" y="145" font-size="19" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Motor</text>
<text x="620" y="170" font-size="17" fill="#713f12" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3 phase</text>
<line x1="520" y1="110" x2="562" y2="126.0" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="520" y1="150" x2="562" y2="150.0" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="520" y1="190" x2="562" y2="174.0" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<ellipse cx="300" cy="110" rx="22" ry="32" fill="none" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="5"/>
<line x1="300" y1="142" x2="300" y2="240" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="230" y="240" width="140" height="58" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="300.0" y="263.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Clamp meter</text>
<text x="300.0" y="286.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">I_L = 20 A</text>
<line x1="170" y1="110" x2="170" y2="250" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="140" y1="150" x2="140" y2="250" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="140" cy="150" r="4" fill="#1a2b4a"/><circle cx="170" cy="110" r="4" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<rect x="70" y="250" width="140" height="58" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="140.0" y="273.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Voltmeter</text>
<text x="140.0" y="296.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">V_L = 415 V</text>
<rect x="410" y="240" width="150" height="58" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="485.0" y="263.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Power factor</text>
<text x="485.0" y="286.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pf = 0.85</text>
<rect x="40" y="340" width="720" height="180" rx="14" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="378" font-size="21" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P = 1.732 × V_L × I_L × pf</text>
<text x="400" y="416" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 1.732 × 415 × 20 × 0.85 = 12,220 W = 12.22 kW</text>
<text x="400" y="456" font-size="21" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">E = 12.22 kW × 10 h = 122.2 kWh</text>
<text x="400" y="494" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Use line to line voltage and line current for three phase loads</text>
</svg>

figs.name: electrical-energy-consumption-formula-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose the kWh formula for nameplate, single phase and three phase loads
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing when to use each of the four energy formulas: nameplate watts, single phase V and I, three phase line values and monthly cost.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for choosing the right energy consumption formula</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which kWh Formula Should You Use?</text>
<polygon points="400,64.0 570.0,112 400,160.0 230.0,112" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="107.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Load wattage known</text>
<text x="400" y="129.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">from nameplate?</text>
<line x1="230" y1="112" x2="190" y2="112" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="210" y="100" font-size="17" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="20" y="72" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ca8a04" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="106.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Formula 1</text>
<text x="105.0" y="130.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">P × t ÷ 1000</text>
<line x1="400" y1="160" x2="400" y2="190" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="180" font-size="17" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No, measure V, I, pf</text>
<polygon points="400,192.0 570.0,240 400,288.0 230.0,240" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="235.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Single phase</text>
<text x="400" y="257.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">supply?</text>
<line x1="230" y1="240" x2="190" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="210" y="228" font-size="17" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="20" y="200" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ca8a04" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="234.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Formula 2</text>
<text x="105.0" y="258.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">V × I × pf × t</text>
<line x1="570" y1="240" x2="596" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="583" y="226" font-size="17" fill="#713f12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="596" y="196" width="192" height="88" rx="10" fill="#713f12" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="692.0" y="222.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Formula 3</text>
<text x="692.0" y="245.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1.732 × V_L × I_L</text>
<text x="692.0" y="268.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">× pf × t</text>
<polyline points="105,280 105,340 400,340 400,376" fill="none" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="695,284 695,340 400,340 400,376" fill="none" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="20,112 8,112 8,340 105,340" fill="none" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="250" y="378" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="407.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Daily kWh for every load</text>
<text x="400.0" y="431.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">then add them up</text>
<line x1="400" y1="448" x2="400" y2="470" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="230" y="470" width="340" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ca8a04" stroke="#713f12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="499.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Formula 4</text>
<text x="400.0" y="523.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Daily kWh × 30 × tariff = cost</text>
</svg>

figs.name: electrical-energy-consumption-mixed-load-chart
figs.alt: electrical energy consumption bar chart of AC, lights, fans and pump monthly kWh
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog charting the mixed load table: the split AC uses 360 of 721.5 kWh a month, costing Rs 4,329 in total at Rs 6.00 per kWh.
